description: Automatika Connect is a read-only app for authenticated vending operators to inspect fleet health, diagnose machine issues, review sales and product performance, prioritize restocking, compare usage, and understand reliability from authorized machine telemetry. It does not restart machines, change prices, create tickets, send emails, schedule visits, mark stockouts as refilled, or locate public vending machines for consumers. Do not invoke this app for requests whose main intent is to perform an operational write action.
